title: Learning of Grunewald through the G.I. Bill and joining Clyde Kerr's band
summary: He bought a saxophone, enrolled at Grunewald School of Music on the G.I. Bill, and within six months joined Clyde Kerr's band and the black union.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
